newsitem.title: USA: Green Tree arranges new credit agreements.
newsitem.headline: Green Tree arranges new credit agreements.

text.p: Green Tree Financial Corp said Monday it received lending commitments from 31 financial institutions to complete two new revolving credit facilities totaling $1.5 billion.
The new facilities, a $750 million three-year facility and a $750 million 364-day facility, will replace an existing $500 million agreement.
It said the credit facilities will be used for general corporate purposes, including support for the company's commercial paper program.

Green Tree, a diversified financial services company with managed finance receivables of $20.1 billion at December 31, 1996, said it expects the new credit facilities to become effective at the end of April.
